name: @vizejs/ui-tooling
description: Workspace-internal source-quality tooling for Vize UI packages

scripts.check: vp check authoring-contract.ts authoring-gate.ts authoring-gate-events.test.ts authoring-gate-filenames.test.ts authoring-gate-slots.test.ts authoring-gate.test.ts lint-sfc.ts lint-sfc.test.ts source-install-planner.ts source-install-planner.test.ts source-install-planner.types.test-d.ts type-member-parser.ts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.fmt: vp fmt --write authoring-contract.ts authoring-contract.md authoring-gate.ts authoring-gate-events.test.ts authoring-gate-filenames.test.ts authoring-gate-slots.test.ts authoring-gate.test.ts lint-sfc.ts lint-sfc.test.ts source-install-planner.ts source-install-planner.behavior.md source-install-planner.test.ts source-install-planner.types.test-d.ts type-member-parser.ts
scripts.test: vp exec node --test authoring-gate-events.test.ts authoring-gate-filenames.test.ts authoring-gate-slots.test.ts authoring-gate.test.ts lint-sfc.test.ts source-install-planner.test.ts
